ideas.name: stop run reclaimed
ideas.why: a poke under the last 20 minutes' low that closes back above it ran the stops below; with them filled, sellers are spent

ideas.name: overnight inventory correction
ideas.why: if the night ended heavily long (close in the top of its range), the morning unwinds some of that inventory

ideas.name: narrow day, first-hour break
ideas.why: a day well under its usual range stores orders; the next day's first-hour break of the prior day's range releases them

ideas.name: flip1 on a trend day (beyond the IB by half its range)
ideas.why: once a day has broken out of its first hour by half that range, it is trending: flips its way continue, against it fail

ideas.name: potE1 against the 15m box
ideas.why: a 1m warning calling a turn back toward the 15m trend is a pullback ending

ideas.name: potE5 against VWAP slope
ideas.why: confirmed #1 on 1m: warnings agreeing with VWAP's slope are weak; does it hold for the 5m EMA row

ideas.name: potM5 against VWAP slope
ideas.why: the same for the 5m MACD row

ideas.name: lead in the morning
ideas.why: a failed bounce in the first two hours, when trends are set, carries further
